content.text: Every preferred element is present in § 18; no redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 is a full vendor insurance clause that meets the preferred position on every element: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate; professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (unconditional, so it covers Cobalt's processing of Customer Data); and workers' compensation as required by law. Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request, plus favourable extras for us (primary coverage, cancellation notice, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities). Coverage also runs for the term plus one year. No deviation; nothing to redline.
